title: Red Rocks Morning Hike
includes: Water Refills and Biodegradable Cups are Provided
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

*This is a moderate hike at altitude that guests may find challenging. This tour is not recommended for people who do not regularly exercise. Out of respect for the other guests on the tour, please consider our sightseeing tours if you are unsure if you can meet the physical requirements. Our guides reserve the right to ask guests to stop or turn around on the hike.
policies: Dress code: wear comfortable clothing, bring layers
From November to April, waterproof shoes are highly recommended. Wool socks are also recommended.
This tour does NOT visit Rocky Mountain National Park. Please consider either our full-day hiking or sightseeing tour that operates in the National Park.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
If you're seeking a quick adventure, take a four hour tour that treats you to a few of the best things of Colorado. Your tour guide Gem gives you locals only insight into the front range before you set off from gorgeous Red Rocks Park for a hike at the base of Red Rocks and Morrison Slide Trail. 
Following the moderate two-three mile hike, relax and unwind at a local coffee shop downtown Golden, Colorado. Sip something warm, savor the moment, and take in the mountain town vibes before we head back down to Denver.
